english.title: Failing to surrender revoked large goods vehicle licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person whose large goods vehicle driver's licence had been revoked under section 115 of the Road Traffic Act 1988, failed without reasonable excuse to deliver the

(A)_[licence]_
(B)_[licence and its counterpart]_

to the Secretary of State forthwith
english.legislation: Contrary to section 118(3)of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
